title: Build To Survive MONSTERS      REMOVE ALL BUILDS INVITE ALL
script:
--made by jn

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Honeypot")
    :WaitForChild("Internal")
    :WaitForChild("RemoteStorage")
    :WaitForChild("ReturnSuccessfulInvite - RemoteEvent")

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
        pcall(function()
            remote:FireServer(player.UserId)
        end)
        task.wait()
    end
end
